wholeApiObligations.status: Unchanged; inherited and underscore-prefixed returned interfaces, helpers, enums, collections and APIs without source tests remain public obligations. Repeat is an operation, not a replacement for Slides or Presentation live objects.

originalEvidenceStatus: Original implementation cases pass; exact staged package 175 files / 4344 tests and actual CLI 9 cases verified. See docs/plans/pptx-template-repeat.md for final checks and corpus limitations. These are new behavior cases, not added source-parity counts.
originalBehaviorCases: Zero records removes only designated prototypes and leaves other slides ordered.
One record creates a graph-owned bound replacement.
Many records expand in record order then requested prototype order, at the first selected source position.
Repeated identical calls have identical output IDs and bytes.
Notes ownership and chart/workbook dependencies belong to the correct instances.
Shared-media reuses admitted media while isolated-instance separates media dependencies.
Timing targets and intra-record slide links refer to copied objects.
Aggregate payload, slide, part, relationship and serialized output limits apply across the whole repeat.
A later invalid record returns no output and does not alter source or destination.
SDK operation and CLI template apply accept the same typed repeat JSON.
legal: Original wording and assets; retain upstream-license-notice.txt and test-case-map-notice.txt separately. No source implementation or corpus bytes copied.
